title: Add Whisper to bots
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Whisper](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.leiver.whisper_android) to bots
- This application allows users to use different AI models to analyze the screen and audio requests through an overlay, using Pollinations AI

Fixes #12706

gist.headline: A whisper joins the hive
gist.blurb: Whisper has landed in the bot garden. It uses a friendly overlay to bring Pollinations models to whatever is happening on your screen or in your audio.
gist.summary: Added Whisper, an Android overlay app that lets users send screen and audio context to different Pollinations AI models, to the community bots directory.
gist.impact: People can now discover Whisper as a ready-made way to analyze on-screen activity and audio with Pollinations models without leaving the app they are using.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Whisper as a cozy Android phone with a translucent assistant overlay observing a tiny screen scene and sound-wave flowers. Polli should hover beside it wearing small headphones and a helpful messenger bag, tending the audio-wave garden while a retro terminal connects the overlay to Pollinations models.

Lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently from a retro terminal and code-plants around the phone, with warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach pastels; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'WHISPER'.
